nodes.label: Weinberger: entire fairness for cash-out merger (fair dealing and fair price)

props.proposition: A cash-out merger by a controlling parent is reviewed for entire fairness, comprising fair dealing and fair price.

nodes.label: MFW: business judgment review for conditioned controller squeeze-out

props.proposition: Business judgment review applies to a controller squeeze-out merger if conditioned from the outset on approval by an independent, empowered special committee and an informed, uncoerced majority-of-the-minority vote.

nodes.label: Corwin: cleansing stockholder vote in non-controller transaction

props.proposition: A transaction not involving a controlling stockholder, approved by a fully informed, uncoerced vote of disinterested stockholders, receives business judgment review.
props.lawyer_question: No fact keys exist for 'fully informed / uncoerced' outside the controller MFW context; bjr_when is under-specified. Propose CR for general stockholder_vote_informed / stockholder_vote_uncoerced keys?

nodes.label: Match Group: MFW required for business judgment in controller transactions generally

props.proposition: Entire fairness applies to controller transactions in which the controller receives a non-ratable benefit unless all MFW conditions are met.

nodes.label: Match Group: every special committee member must be independent

props.proposition: To satisfy MFW's committee prong, all members of the special committee, not merely a majority, must be independent of the controller.

nodes.label: Rutledge: SB 21 section 144 amendments upheld as constitutional

props.proposition: The 2025 amendments to DGCL section 144, including the safe harbors and their retroactive application, do not violate the Delaware Constitution (certified questions answered in the negative).

nodes.label: 8 Del. C. section 144(b) (as amended by SB 21): controller transactions other than going private

props.modeling_gap: Statute also requires disclosure to the committee or stockholders; no fact key exists for it (CR needed). Stockholder prong modeled per Doc 02 s9.3 (either fact).

nodes.label: 8 Del. C. section 144(c) (as amended by SB 21): going private transactions

props.modeling_gap: Going private defined by reference to Rule 13e-3 for public companies; not modeled beyond transaction_type.

props.rationale: Match Group applies and extends the MFW framework.
